title: ConversionRun submit request
description: The body of POST /api/v1/conversion-runs, table 10.2-B row R16, bound to conversion_run.submit. Chapter 19 gives conversion no screen, so this is not a console route and MOS-UI-101's no-digest rule does not reach it; it is declared because register entry 79 names ConversionRun among the three entities the API surface is missing and because a conversion that is performed outside the API and recorded afterwards is a ModelVersion whose equivalence evidence nobody watched being produced. THE ONE MEMBER THAT IS NOT HERE IS THE POINT: there is no tolerances member, and there is no per-case skip. MOS-TRAIN-164 states it exactly -- a conversion failing any tolerance MUST NOT be registered, the remedy is a different conversion (another precision class, another opset, a different plugin or layer-fusion configuration) and never a relaxed tolerance on that version, because a tolerance relaxed to admit one artifact silently relaxes it for every future artifact of that family. medos/medos/training/conversion.py already refuses to take such an argument; a request schema that accepted one would reintroduce at the edge what the engine refuses in the middle. MOS-TRAIN-162 lets a ModelVersion declare TIGHTER values, which is a comparison the platform performs against the registered version and never a value this body supplies.

source_model_version_id.description: MOS-TRAIN-169: a SUSPENDED or RECALLED source is refused before the row exists. MOS-TRAIN-166 makes the converted version reference the SAME PreprocessingSpec version as its derived_from source with a byte-identical golden-fixture output tensor -- preprocessing is not what changed -- so no preprocessing member appears in this body; a conversion that needed one is a new lineage under MOS-IMG-046 and not a conversion at all.

toolchain.description: The exporter and its versions, as recorded. A tensorrt_plan additionally records built_for -- cuda_compute_capability, tensorrt_version, cuda_version -- which the platform reads from the building host rather than from this body, because a plan is only loadable on the hardware it was built for and a client's claim about that hardware is the one fact a later loader cannot check.

equivalence_cohort_digest.description: The JCS digest of the ordered patient_key list the E1/E2/E3 check will run over, as medos/medos/training/conversion.py equivalence_cohort_digest() computes it. Named rather than derived because the cohort is a choice the caller makes and MOS-TRAIN-161 requires all three quantities to be computed per case on a stated cohort; a server-chosen cohort would make the equivalence result depend on a selection nobody recorded.

calibration_dataset_version_id.description: Required exactly when precision is int8 and forbidden otherwise; 0013 carries the same biconditional as a CHECK and the allOf below carries it on the wire.

calibration_partition.description: MOS-TRAIN-157: calibrating on test is operating-point selection on the test set under another name. The value is a const rather than an enum of one, so the schema states a rule instead of offering a choice with one option.
